02 / The learning direction

Understand the process.
Notice the difference.

A proposed learning path built around the fundamentals of powder coating.

I

Surface & preparation.

Recognize the substrate, understand why surface condition matters, and connect preparation with coating performance.

II

Powder & application.

Build familiarity with coating materials, application equipment, and the way a part’s shape affects the work.

III

Cure & quality.

Understand the role of curing and develop an eye for the appearance and consistency of a finished surface.

Academy concept: topics are illustrative. Course formats, curriculum, enrollment, and the opening date will be announced when confirmed.
